lessons.claim: A direct comparison of a DLVO central-force bond vs the JKR bending stiffness (n=9, ω=3000, a=632nm, the same 6 seeds, the bending term alone ON/OFF): K' 199.5±69.9 vs 43064±2516 = **216x**. The response amplitude |ŷ| agrees with the linear-response prediction to +1.3%, independent evidence that the implementation is right. The discriminating power is best for the bow (the maximum deviation from the straight line joining the two ends) -- DLVO 0.1135±0.0048 d vs JKR 0.00639±0.00011 d, a separation of **22.3σ** (K' gives 17.0σ). ★ JKR's K' is 4.5x the static-limit prediction (9628), and that is not an error but because De=10.7 so it is not quasi-static (K''=120022 > K' corroborates it). A quasi-static quantitative comparison needs ω<28 rad/s, which at 25 hours per seed is not run.
